clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau breaks the mind into three parts: the analytical mind that only sees the facts - your bills, your income, what you can afford - the subconscious mind running below your awareness, and the reactive mind, the one that gets "triggered."

Here's the part that stings: if someone can push your buttons, Kevin says, it means he can control you like a puppet on a string. One word is all it takes.

Eliminate the reactive mind and that power disappears. You can still respond - you just can't be pushed around.

Which one is actually running your day?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #emotionalcontrol #selfmastery #subconsciousmind #mindovermatter

Kevin Trudeau spent eight and a half years in prison for contempt of court - never charged with a crime. While he was there, he taught other inmates how to control their minds instead of reacting to everything around them.

One of those men was a drug dealer. He got out, cleaned up, and built an online business. Today he makes a million dollars a month.

His own words: it made him feel like Superman - in control of his life instead of controlled by it.

What would you build if nothing could trigger you?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfdiscipline #successstory #emotionalcontrol #wealthmindset

Kevin Trudeau teaches something simple that almost nobody practices: leave space between stimulus and response.

Most people react instantly - no pause, no processing, just a reflex. Then they say, "I didn't mean to say that." But if you didn't mean it, Kevin asks, why did you say it?

Because you reacted. It wasn't a conscious choice - it was your reactive mind talking before you did.

Give yourself that half-second. It changes everything that comes out of your mouth next.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfcontrol #emotionalintelligence #personalgrowth #selfmastery

Kevin Trudeau says wealthy people's brains broadcast on a different wave - right between alpha and theta. He calls it the billionaire brainwave. Stay in beta too long, he says, and you're stuck broadcasting the poverty wave instead.

Here's the part most people miss: wanting more money isn't enough if something invisible keeps pushing back. A headwind. A thousand pounds on your back for no reason you can name.

Kevin calls that counter intention - and until you clear it, the wanting alone won't move you anywhere.

Have you ever felt that invisible resistance?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #lawofattraction #wealthmindset #subconsciousmind #mindset

You land the deal. Then you get drunk the night before, show up late, and blow it. Why would you do that?

Kevin Trudeau calls it a counter intention - a subconscious program working against the very thing you say you want. It shows up in relationships too: get burned once, and some part of you decides never to trust again, so you sabotage the next one before it even starts.

You didn't do it on purpose. That's the problem - you did it without knowing.

What program might be running underneath what you want?

Five thousand dollars in savings. Eighteen months later: eight million.

That's not a one-off. People tell Kevin Trudeau the same kind of thing constantly - income doubled, then tripling, relationships they'd given up on finally showing up.

The common thread in every story: they stopped waiting for motivation and started applying the actual formula, the same one wealthy families have quietly passed down for generations.

Numbers like that don't happen by accident.
